title: Founder Live Approval Capture Boundary
objective: Define governed local approval capture boundaries for future founder/operator decisions without granting approval capture, approval persistence, approval writes, runtime admission, execution unlock, mutation, deploy, network, or spend authority.
safetyRules: No approval capture writes that unlock execution.
No runtime admission or live mode transition.
No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
No full Command Center demo leakage.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence, audit, and activity helpers

subphases.title: Approval Capture Contract / Schema Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define the P107 approval capture boundary contract and local schema without enabling approval capture, approval persistence, approval writes, execution unlock, runtime admission, or mutation.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.envelope: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, sourceApprovalRequestQueuePhase, sourceApprovalRequestQueueState, founderContextSummary, approvalCaptureBoundaryShape, approvalCaptureDecisionShape, approvalCaptureReadiness, requiredEvidence, forbiddenActions, requiredEvidenceCount, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible false, and all approval capture/runtime/execution flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.approvalCaptureBoundaryShape: Display-safe approval capture boundary with captureBoundaryKey, displayLabel, sourceApprovalRequestPhase, currentState, queuedRequestCount, capturedDecisionCount 0, persistedDecisionCount 0, executionUnlockCount 0, runtimeAdmissionCount 0, requiredEvidence, missingEvidence, forbiddenActions, validationCommands, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and all blocked flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.approvalCaptureDecisionShape: Display-safe approval capture decision boundary with decisionBoundaryKey, displayLabel, currentState, decisionOptions, decisionCaptureAllowed false, decisionPersistenceAllowed false, decisionCanUnlockExecution false, runtimeTransitionAllowed false, validationCommands, disabledReason, and all blocked flags false.
